english.title: Money laundering - tip off regarding money laundering investigation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing or suspecting that a constable was

(A)_[acting]_
(B)_[proposing to act]_

in connection with an investigation which was

(C)_[being]_
(D)_[about to be]_

conducted into money laundering, disclosed to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) information or any other matter which was likely to prejudice the

(E)_[investigation]_
(F)_[proposed investigation]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 93D(1) and (9) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
know/suspect that a constable is acting/proposing to act in connection with investigation
being/about to be conducted into money laundering disclosed
information/other matter likely prejudice the investigation/proposed investigation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.
(ii) TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS PERMIT THIS LEGISLATION TO BE USED FOR ANY OFFENCE WHICH STARTED BEFORE ITS REPEAL EVEN IF THE OFFENCE WAS NOT COMPLETE UNTIL AFTER THE 23rd FEBRUARY 2003 (Statutory instrument 2003/120)

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six Months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
